label: soco81 coal incremental hr
definition: soco-81 (2019-2025): soco-76 keeper recipe + coal_econ_marginal_hr_two_sided -- SOCO's must-run-floored coal (Bowen, Miller, Scherer, Daniel, Gaston) prices its committed/econ tranches at its own measured incremental heat rate (0.77-1.08 x average); cyclers keep the average.
market_story: COAL_PRB/COAL_BIT up, CC_REGULAR/CT_PEAKER down: a boiler held on at its minimum-load floor has already paid its no-load fuel, so the next MWh costs only the incremental burn off its own CEMS input-output curve (3-11 % below the plant average at Miller, Scherer, Daniel and Gaston). Offered at that cost, the floored units stay loaded through more shoulder hours against the CC fleet, as the real Southern Company dispatch does; the start-cost-free cyclers keep the average, which is where their no-load heat lives.
